## Loch Tay Safaris

#### Explore The Loch Discover the Story - The ultimate way to experience Loch Tay!

- [![Click to enlarge image Interior_LTS.jpeg](https://visitaberfeldy.co.uk/plugins/content/jw_sigpro/jw_sigpro/includes/images/transparent.gif)](https://visitaberfeldy.co.uk/images/stories/com_form2content/p1/f8/gallery17/Interior_LTS.jpeg "")
- [![Click to enlarge image ben_lawers_and_boat.jpeg](https://visitaberfeldy.co.uk/plugins/content/jw_sigpro/jw_sigpro/includes/images/transparent.gif)](https://visitaberfeldy.co.uk/images/stories/com_form2content/p1/f8/gallery17/ben_lawers_and_boat.jpeg "")
- [![Click to enlarge image prow_2.jpeg](https://visitaberfeldy.co.uk/plugins/content/jw_sigpro/jw_sigpro/includes/images/transparent.gif)](https://visitaberfeldy.co.uk/images/stories/com_form2content/p1/f8/gallery17/prow_2.jpeg "")
- [![Click to enlarge image twin_engine.jpeg](https://visitaberfeldy.co.uk/plugins/content/jw_sigpro/jw_sigpro/includes/images/transparent.gif)](https://visitaberfeldy.co.uk/images/stories/com_form2content/p1/f8/gallery17/twin_engine.jpeg "")

View the embedded image gallery online at:


[https://visitaberfeldy.co.uk/see-do/266-loch-tay-safaris#sigProIde329a9d163](https://visitaberfeldy.co.uk/see-do/266-loch-tay-safaris#sigProIde329a9d163 "Loch Tay Safaris")

Click on a thumbnail to see image gallery.

![](https://visitaberfeldy.co.uk/images/stories/com_form2content/p1/f8/mainpictureLTS.jpeg)

Have fun on Loch Tay as you skim over the surface of the waters of Perthshire's largest and one of Scotland's deepest lochs! Surrounded by stunning and dramatic landscape, in an area steeped in history, myths and folklore you will be mesmerised by mystical and spell binding stories of the people who have shaped the very fabric of this amazing area throughout the ages. Our state of the art RIB (Rigid Inflatable Boat) has been named Iolaire; Gaelic for Eagle. She has a heated cabin and fitted with twin 300HP Evinrude engines capable of speeds of more than 40 knots (45 MPH!) - that makes her the BIGGEST and FASTEST boat on Loch Tay!

She can seat up to 12 passengers in comfortable, individual seats. With on deck viewing platforms, front and back, you can feel the wind in your hair and connected to everything that makes Loch Tay so memorable.

Book online at [https://www.lochtaysafaris.net/book/](https://www.lochtaysafaris.net/book/)

Daily departures from April to November.

Departure times:1000-1200-1400hrs (1600 -1800hrs during Peak season)

Lochtay Safaris

Taymouth Marina

Kenmore

PH15 2HW

Email: [info@lochtaysafaris.net](mailto:info@lochtaysafaris.net)

Phone: 01887 820071
